errors.text_span: 后段叠加为蓝色星形标记
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the latter part of the data series has blue star markers superimposed ('叠加'). In the figure, the markers are blue circles for the first few epochs (1-4), and then they change to blue stars for the rest of the epochs (5-30). They are not superimposed; the marker shape changes.
The description does not mention the presence of an empty legend box in the top right corner of the plot.
The description omits the presence of the grid lines in the background of the chart.
